logic: All mandatory document types must be present before final decision.
Invoice total must not exceed credit amount plus configured tolerance.
Invoice and packing-list quantity must reconcile with LC quantity and tolerance.
On-board shipment date must be within allowed shipment period.
Purchase-order reference must reconcile across LC and invoice.
Invoice fingerprint must not match another financed/presented invoice unless approved linkage is found.
Confirmed sanctions match blocks workflow; potential match routes to approved screening process.
Route/port/vessel matches against current approved policy lists.
Unit price outside configured range requires analyst review.
Non-standard clause or open-ended liability requires legal and credit approval.
Demand must contain each statement/document explicitly required by the guarantee.
Release documents only after instruction-defined payment or acceptance event.
Track import evidence/IDPMS status according to approved bank workflow.
Create follow-up task for overdue export bill or unresolved realization evidence.
